description: Completed P0-2 candidate audit using the adaptive full-Liouvillian spectrum and the archived broad-window sweep
manuscript_label: positive coherence-sector response with a Fano-shaped narrow feature
caveat: The adaptive feature window robustly favors Fano, but broad-window Fano-versus-Lorentzian selection is background-window sensitive. Do not claim a uniquely identified microscopic Fano mechanism.
verdict: The 70 K candidate is not spectroscopic EIT. It is a positive selection-rule-controlled sector response whose local narrow feature is Fano-shaped; the large ATS-minus-EIT value rejects ATS but does not establish EIT.
